name: BIS CARE Portal & Mobile App
description: Verify ISI Mark Licences, CRS Registration R-Numbers, 6-digit Gold Hallmarking HUID, and file consumer complaints online.

name: Manakonline (e-BIS Portal)
description: Unified digital portal for applying for new BIS Product Certification (Scheme I), CRS Registration (Scheme II), and Hallmarking registration.

name: Know Your Standard (KYS)
description: Search, preview, and download authoritative Indian Standards, amendments, Scheme of Inspection & Testing (SIT), and technical committees.

name: BIS LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System)
description: Comprehensive portal to search BIS-recognized and NABL accredited laboratories, evaluate test scope, and track sample testing status.

name: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) Portal
description: Dedicated portal for Electronics, IT Goods, Solar PV, and Lithium Batteries under MeitY and MNRE mandatory orders.

name: Hallmarking & Assaying Portal
description: Manage jeweller registration, locate Assaying and Hallmarking Centres (AHC), and verify hallmarked jewellery tracking.
